blocks.text: RESIDENTIAL LEASE AGREEMENT
This agreement is made between [A.ORG_1] (the Landlord) and [A.ORG_2] (the Tenant).
1. Premises
1.1. The Landlord leases to the Tenant a furnished apartment for residential use only.
2. Rent and deposit
2.1. The monthly rent is USD 700, payable by the 5th day of each month.
2.2. The Tenant pays a security deposit of USD 700. The Landlord returns it within 14 days after the end of the lease.
3. Term and termination
3.1. The lease term is 12 months.
3.2. The Tenant may terminate the lease at any time with 30 days' written notice, without any fee or penalty.
4. Repairs
4.1. The Landlord carries out major repairs at its own cost.
5. Access
5.1. The Landlord may inspect the apartment with 3 days' notice.
6. Notices
6.1. Notices are sent by email to the addresses given in the preamble of this agreement.
7. Governing law
7.1. This agreement is governed by the law of Ukraine.
8. Final provisions
8.1. This agreement is made in two copies, one for each party.
8.2. Changes are valid only if made in writing and signed by both parties.
